order: warmup A, warmup B, measurements A B B A

resources.pool_scope: greedy 3 GiB configured per Sail process; container hard cap 12 GiB

measurement_scopes.timer: receipt.end_to_end_seconds: traversal execution through final Parquet write, after lazy input DataFrames are constructed; excludes server startup, independent correctness validation and cleanup (pinned traversal_cell.py:27-97)
measurement_scopes.memory: sampled container-process PSS/RSS phase execute; distinct from cgroup total memory counters
measurement_scopes.steal: full-trial, whole Linux VM /proc/stat delta; not the execution timer interval, container or assigned cpuset (pinned graph_cell.py:558-559)
measurement_scopes.ratios: shared-host descriptive ratios only; original smoke times excluded; no absolute performance claim

configuration_parity: All six normalize to the same digest after removing only run_id, host_output, runtime_source_sha, container_sail_binary and suite.name; dry plans retain commands.

gate.scope: detached content candidate gate; no commit/Sail binary verdict

launch_policy: Command is prepared, not executed. Parent must separately authorize scheduling after logging02. Use a detached process with redirected log for long supervision; runner writes per-cell progress, raw diagnostics and sequence/summary durably. --through permits an explicitly authorized prefix; no automatic retries.
admission: No running Docker containers and >=12GiB free before every cell. Point-in-time admission plus sampled concurrency, not a host-wide lock or dedicated-host proof.
stopping: Runner wall deadline2400s; bounded cleanup. Timeout halts later cells. Admission/source/disk failures preserve error receipt and halt; completed benchmark failure outcomes remain separate and may continue within authorized prefix.
retention: No deletion, bootstrap, source/native/controller changes, cache flush or previous smoke overwrite. Previous smoke times are not comparison samples. Full artifacts remain in VM; top-level diagnostics copied by pinned safe runner.
